attributes.value: Write a comprehensive technical blog post about Rust async programming

attributes.constraints: Exactly 3 parallel sections: (1) core async concepts, (2) Tokio runtime internals, (3) common pitfalls and patterns. Each section should be self-contained.

attributes.evidence: The post should be technically accurate about Rust async/await, Tokio, and common async patterns.

metadata.description: PLAN decomposes a goal into 3 sections, parallel ASK nodes write each section, WAIT_ALL syncs them, THINK assembles the final post, VERIFY checks quality, CHECKPOINT saves the result.
metadata.pattern: plan → fan-out → wait-all → think → verify → checkpoint
